segs: This is the world's easiest home security camera. You can mount this to your fence,
to your house, or even to a tree. It's 100% solar powered, and you don't even have to have
sunlight for this to work. And it even has full 360 degree motion tracking, left and right,
and even up and down. It can be accessed on all your smart home devices. You can remote
control it from your phone and access it anywhere in the world. And my favorite thing is,
you don't have to have a subscription. You can just use an SD card. The solar panel
keeps this camera charged all day, and the backup battery keeps it running all night.
And this can even operate for multiple weeks without any sunlight. It's called the
Wise Solar Campaign, and I actually linked it down below because it's finally back in stock
for the first time in six months.
